title: Grant admin role to current user

requirements.summary: Add an admin self-promotion UI flow allowing authenticated users to claim admin access when no admin exists yet
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Claim Admin Access' button is shown to authenticated users who are not yet admins on the Admin page
Clicking the button calls the backend grant-admin function
On success, the user is immediately granted access to the AdminPanel without a page reload
If the claim fails (e.g., admin slot already taken), an informative error toast is shown
AdminGuard correctly reflects the new admin status after claiming

file_operations.description: Add a React Query mutation hook useGrantAdminRole that wraps the backend grantAdminRole function. The mutation should accept a Principal parameter and call actor.grantAdminRole(candidate). On success, invalidate the 'isCallerAdmin' and 'callerUserRole' query keys to trigger a refresh of the admin status throughout the app.

Extend AdminGuard to display a 'Claim Admin Access' button when the user is authenticated but isAdmin returns false. Use the authorization component's pattern for self-promotion: render a centered card with explanatory text ('No admin exists yet. Claim admin access to manage this application.') and a primary button. On button click, invoke the useGrantAdminRole mutation with the current user's principal. Show a loading state while the mutation is pending. On success, the invalidated queries will automatically re-fetch and grant access to children. On error, display a toast with the error message (e.g., 'Admin access already claimed by another user').
